title: Walk and degree classes of corank at most one (Theorem DWC1) are reconstructible
statement_en: Theorem DWC1 (round-14 t2.md (Theorem H, aligned Hagos) and t3.md (Theorems DWC, WR) in the phantom_and_mate directory of the diameter-2 branch): every graph G on at least 3 vertices such that any two integer vectors f, g orthogonal to every walk vector A^k 1 of G (k ≥ 0) and summing to zero over every degree class of G are linearly dependent over the integers (the walk vectors and degree-class indicators span all but at most one dimension) is reconstructible.
statement_lean: Recon.ClassReconstructible (fun n G => ∀ w : ℕ → Fin n → ℤ, (∀ x : Fin n, w 0 x = 1) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x : Fin n, w (k + 1) x = ∑ y : Fin n, Set.indicator (G.neighborSet x) (w k) y) → ∀ f g : Fin n → ℤ, (∀ k : ℕ, ∑ x : Fin n, f x * w k x = 0) → (∀ j : ℕ, ∑ x : Fin n, Set.indicator {x : Fin n | (G.neighborSet x).ncard = j} f x = 0) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∑ x : Fin n, g x * w k x = 0) → (∀ j : ℕ, ∑ x : Fin n, Set.indicator {x : Fin n | (G.neighborSet x).ncard = j} g x = 0) → ∃ a b : ℤ, (a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ x : Fin n, a * f x + b * g x = 0)
author: round14
